evals.prompt: Add a function that computes the discounted price given a price and a percentage discount, in this toy JS repo. Make sure it's well tested.
evals.fixture: a minimal git repo with package.json (node --test), empty src/ and test/
assertions: A test file exists with behavior-named tests (e.g. "applies a discount"), not test1/test2
Tests cover edge cases beyond the happy path (0% discount, 100% discount, or invalid input)
No test recomputes the expected value the way the implementation does (tautological assertion)
Tests exercise the function's public interface, not internals
A git commit was made on the current branch
The user was asked to run to-review rather than a review panel being launched automatically
